# Delivery schedule

## Screen and conditional land option / M1-M6

Dependency: Landowner willingness, title and desktop fatal-flaw pass

Output: Controlable site with exit rights; survey and constraint map

Status: Proposed conditional schedule

## Gas / fibre / water feasibility and customer design brief / M2-M8

Dependency: Permission for investigations and requested capacity definition

Output: Written provider scope, route plans and tenant interface requirements

Status: Proposed conditional schedule

## County rezoning, environmental fieldwork and engagement / M2-M18

Dependency: Site options and preliminary layout

Output: Applicable land-use consent and technically complete applications

Status: Proposed conditional schedule

## BYOG qualification, AESO / TFO studies and agreements / M2-M36

Dependency: Final published process and eligible paired generation

Output: Study-approved connection, cost and operating envelope; no guaranteed completion month

Status: Proposed conditional schedule

## Plant air/noise and AUC authorization / M5-M24

Dependency: OEM emissions assumptions and viable receptors study

Output: Approved plant and associated facilities with conditions

Status: Proposed conditional schedule

## Anchor lease, EPC scope and financing gate / M6-M14

Dependency: Site/power feasibility and credible total cost

Output: Conditional 25 MW lease; FID only when finance conditions precedent met

Status: Proposed conditional schedule

## Long-lead equipment engineering and manufacture / M8-M38

Dependency: Equity-funded conditional reservations / limited notices at M8; permit and cancellation exposure expressly approved; full releases only after relevant gates

Output: Transformers, engines, MV switchgear, UPS and cooling assemblies

Status: Proposed conditional schedule

## Shared infrastructure and block 1 civil / shell / M20-M34

Dependency: Issued approvals, civil design and finance close

Output: Roads, drainage, utility yards and first 25 MW shell

Status: Proposed conditional schedule

## Block 1 fit-out, 60 MW gas stage and commissioning / M30-M42

Dependency: Equipment delivery, gas and grid commissioning authorizations

Output: 25 MW IT accepted; islanding, thermal and protection tests passed

Status: Proposed conditional schedule

## Block 2 and 90 MW cumulative gas capacity / M36-M51

Dependency: Additional 25 MW contracted; adequate service and finance

Output: 50 MW IT cumulative acceptance

Status: Proposed conditional schedule

## Block 3 and 130 MW cumulative gas capacity / M45-M60

Dependency: Additional 25 MW contracted; operating lessons incorporated

Output: 75 MW IT cumulative acceptance

Status: Proposed conditional schedule

## Block 4 and 160 MW cumulative gas capacity / M54-M69

Dependency: Final 25 MW contracted; service and funding gates

Output: 100 MW IT cumulative acceptance

Status: Proposed conditional schedule
